meta.title: Situaciones hipotéticas
meta.goal: Ya puedes usar segundo condicional en ejemplos claros y adecuados al contexto.

cards.title: Situaciones hipotéticas: qué expresa
cards.lede: Esta lección te ayuda a usar segundo condicional con precisión y sin traducir palabra por palabra.

tip.label: Objetivo:
tip.body: reconocer la intención y elegir correctamente segundo condicional en situaciones reales.

cards.title: La estructura que debes recordar
cards.lede: Observa la forma completa antes de producir tus propios ejemplos.

cards.title: Ejemplos naturales
cards.lede: Lee cada ejemplo como una unidad completa y fíjate en la posición de las palabras.

rows.value: If I had time, I'd travel.
If I were you, I'd apologize.
We could move if prices were lower.

cards.title: Cómo cambia el significado
cards.lede: La elección depende de la intención, la cantidad, el tiempo o el registro.

columns.label: if + pasado
examples: If I had time, I'd travel.

columns.label: would + verbo
examples: If I were you, I'd apologize.

cards.title: Evita este calco
cards.lede: Compara la versión incorrecta con una forma natural y gramatical.

lines.text: If I would have time, I traveled.
If I had time, I would travel.

cards.title: Decisión en cuatro pasos
cards.lede: Usa esta lista para comprobar tu frase antes de continuar.

rows.value: Elige la forma adecuada de segundo condicional.
Revisa sujeto, verbo, número y tiempo.
Lee la frase completa y evita traducir literalmente.

tip.label: Práctica:
tip.body: crea una frase personal con cada patrón y léela en voz alta.

quiz.explain: La respuesta correcta aplica la regla central de segundo condicional.

options: If I would have time, I traveled.
If I had time, I would travel.
quiz.explain: La segunda opción usa la estructura y el orden correctos.

quiz.q: ¿Qué conviene revisar al usar segundo condicional?
options: La intención, la estructura y el contexto.
Solo la traducción literal al español.
quiz.explain: Una frase natural depende del significado, la forma y el contexto, no de traducir palabra por palabra.

transform.source: I don't have enough money, so I don't buy that laptop.
transform.instruction: Reescribe usando segundo condicional con if.
accept: If I had enough money, I would buy that laptop.

transform.source: She is not here, so she cannot help us.
accept: If she were here, she could help us.
If she was here, she could help us.

transform.source: I don't know his number, so I don't call him.
accept: If I knew his number, I would call him.

transform.source: We don't live in the countryside, so we don't have a garden.
accept: If we lived in the countryside, we would have a garden.
If I had a car, I would not take the bus.
If I had a car, I wouldn't take the bus.
If he studied, he would pass his exams.
If I were the manager, I could make this decision.
If I was the manager, I could make this decision.

correct.sentence: If I will have time, I would call you.
accept: If I had time, I would call you.
correct.explanation: La cláusula con if usa pasado simple, nunca will.

correct.sentence: If I were you, I would accept the job offer.
accept: If I were you, I would accept the job offer.

correct.sentence: If she knew the answer, she will tell us.
accept: If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
correct.explanation: En segundo condicional se usa would en la cláusula principal.

correct.sentence: If they lived closer, they would visit us more often.
accept: If they lived closer, they would visit us more often.
correct.explanation: La oración ya está bien estructurada.

correct.sentence: If I would win the lottery, I bought a house.
accept: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.
correct.explanation: If va con pasado simple (won) y el resultado con would + verbo base.

personalize.starter: If I won the lottery, I would
personalize.hintEs: Usa If I won the lottery, I would... y describe tus planes.

personalize.promptEs: ¿A dónde viajarías si tuvieras un mes de vacaciones?
personalize.starter: If I had a month of vacation, I would
personalize.hintEs: Responde usando If I had..., I would visit...

personalize.promptEs: Si pudieras cambiar una cosa de tu rutina diaria, ¿cuál sería?
personalize.starter: If I could change my routine, I would
personalize.hintEs: Escribe usando If I could..., I would...
